checker_default: PASS structural proof and exact Null-B contrast witness
checker_full: PASS 4096-replicate deterministic hashes when run with --full (requires numpy+numba)

exact_null_b_contrast_witness.consequence: Null B is non-degenerate on a registered cell at the first discovery scale while Null A is structurally degenerate there.

hard_target_disposition: NULL_MODEL_MISSPECIFICATION / registered second-order screen cannot be evaluated because Null A overconditions the first three discovery scales to sigma=0; choosing an epsilon, dropping scales/cells, or coarsening microcells now would be post-hoc and forbidden.
smallest_followup_frontier: A corrected generation must choose nuisance strata with a predeclared minimum conditional support/variance rule before any data evaluation; e.g. coarser q microcells or adaptive support floors may be tested only in a new task/publication with fresh holdouts.

structural_obstruction.consequence: At X=1e6,3e6,1e7 every relevant q is below 2^18, so every registered occupancy cell has exact Null-A variance zero. The registered z=(O-mu)/sigma and therefore C and T are undefined at three of five discovery scales.
structural_obstruction.proof: For q<2^18, k=floor(log2 q)<=17. A registered microcell has q-diameter <2^(k-10)<=128<210. Two distinct integers in the same microcell and the same residue mod 210 would differ by a nonzero multiple of 210, impossible. Hence every conditioned microcell/residue stratum has capacity at most one and Null A is the identity on that range.
